summary: Cumulative migration from 1.1.9 through 1.1.15. In addition to the signal/error/session changes, 1.1.14 adds the composable agency client, invitation, earnings, commission, payout-history, and payout-profile UI over keel 1.2.41. Versions 1.1.11 through 1.1.13 were additive and require no separate downstream migration action. 1.1.15 makes errorDetail distinguish transport and non-API failures from backend rejections and adds isTransportFailure.

changes.before: BaseView/BaseForm/table components exposed plain mutable fields: records, displayedColumns, searchTerms, editableRecord, isNew, title, isReadOnlyMode, tabFields, searchColumns, dialogComponent.
changes.after: All of these are signals (or computed). Read with call syntax — records(), editableRecord(), isNew() — and write with .set()/.update(). Manual ChangeDetectorRef.markForCheck() calls are unnecessary and removed.
changes.action: In subclasses, replace field reads/writes with signal calls; delete markForCheck() calls tied to these fields.

changes.before: BaseView carried abstract handleDelete/handleUpdate plus the dialog opener; read-only views had to stub them.
changes.after: BaseView is the read-only listing surface (no abstract members); editing views extend the new AbstractEditableView which owns dialogComponent, addRecord/editRecord/deleteRecord and the abstract handlers.
changes.action: Subclasses that implement handleDelete/handleUpdate now extend AbstractEditableView instead of BaseView. Read-only subclasses extend BaseView and delete their no-op stubs.

changes.before: Templates bound [isReadOnly]="isReadOnlyBound" and handlers re-assigned this.isReadOnlyBound = this.isReadOnly.bind(this) to force OnPush refreshes.
changes.after: isReadOnlyBound is gone. Bind [isReadOnly]="isReadOnlyFn" — a stable arrow property; signal reads inside isReadOnly() overrides are tracked by the invoking template, so mode flips re-render automatically.
changes.action: Replace all isReadOnlyBound bindings with isReadOnlyFn and delete rebinding assignments.

changes.before: RecordForm mutated the bound [record] object in place.
changes.after: RecordForm keeps an internal working copy and emits the full updated object via (recordChange); the input object is never mutated.
changes.action: Add (recordChange)="yourRecordSignal.set($event)" (or equivalent) next to every [record] binding whose edits you consume.

changes.before: BaseAuthService.login()/loginWithGoogle() subscribed internally and returned void; errors went to console only.
changes.after: Both return Observable<LoginResponse2FA>. Nothing happens until you subscribe; the error channel carries login failures for the UI.
changes.action: Audit every call site: append .subscribe({ next, error }) and surface errors. A call without subscribe silently does nothing.

changes.before: BackendService.handleError rethrew the string 'error occurred, see console log and try again'.
changes.after: CRUD errors are SailApiError (extends Error) with .status, .problem (keel RFC 7807 ProblemDetail) and .response (original HttpErrorResponse). handleError(error: unknown) is bound-safe for overrides. The new errorDetail(err, fallback) util maps SailApiError / HttpErrorResponse / Error to a display message.
changes.action: Error handlers that matched the old string must switch to SailApiError or route messages through errorDetail().

changes.before: sail exported IsString/IsNumeric decorators shadowing class-validator names.
changes.after: Renamed IsSailString/IsSailNumeric (constraints IsSailStringConstraint/IsSailNumericConstraint). IsSailNumeric also rejects exponential notation.
changes.action: Rename imports/usages in model files.

changes.before: The AuthSummary interface described the permission index's internal escaped-pattern shape.
changes.after: Removed — the permission index is an internal detail (compiled RegExp) and no public API produces AuthSummary values.
changes.action: Delete imports of AuthSummary; no replacement is needed.

changes.before: No public way to react to a dead session; the interceptor only counted 401s.
changes.after: BaseAuthService.sessionExpired() is public — the auth interceptor calls it (via lazy injection) when the 401 circuit opens or is found already open, clearing the session and routing to login?sessionExpired=true.
changes.action: Subclasses may override sessionExpired() for custom handling; call super to keep the clear+redirect.

changes.before: <sail-payout-bank-info-form> defaulted provider to 'AW' and countryCode to 'CA'.
changes.after: [provider] is a required input; the country default is the first entry of [countryProfiles]. No hardcoded provider/country can leak into user_bank_info.
changes.action: Pass [provider] explicitly, matching your keel --payout_provider.

changes.before: LabelService.GetLabel/LoadLabels (PascalCase); GetLabel returned '' for missing keys.
changes.after: getLabel/loadLabels; getLabel falls back to the key so missing translations are visible.
changes.action: Rename call sites.

changes.before: provider_onboarding, bank_info_form and user_payment_methods shipped styles: blocks (user_payment_methods leaked CSS globally via ViewEncapsulation.None).
changes.after: No CSS ships, matching the rest of the library. Class names are unchanged. provider_onboarding and user_payment_methods now expose BaseAsync's loading()/errorMessage() instead of busy()/errorMsg().
changes.action: Style the .payout-onboarding__*, .bank-info-form*, .user-payment-methods__* classes in the app's global stylesheet if you relied on the shipped look; update any bindings to busy()/errorMsg().

changes.before: TableReport extended BaseRestService and fetched via a hardcoded '/api/' prefix.
changes.after: TableReport injects BackendService and uses its new report() method (honours RestURL.api_prefix and typed errors). Report state resets when apiName changes; an appdata refresh no longer clears typed parameters.
changes.action: Only affects subclasses of TableReport relying on BaseRestService members.

changes.before: BaseAuthService captured every REST URL in field initializers, so configureRestUrls() in a subclass constructor ran too late — URLs baked in host-less. A trailing slash on httpHost also broke interceptor matching (host//api/...).
changes.after: URLs resolve lazily per request and the configured host is normalized. Constructor-time configureRestUrls() is now safe; module-scope calls keep working.
changes.action: Redundant early-call workarounds can be removed.

changes.before: logout() kept the appdata cache, permission index, appdata replay and the authed route tree alive on the login screen; in-flight appdata responses could hydrate the next session.
changes.after: clearSession() drops cache/permissions/roles/loginToken, bumps a session generation (stale in-flight responses are ignored), emits an empty menu state to live subscribers, and restores the pre-login route config. deleteAccount() clears the role too.
changes.action: None, unless app code relied on reading menus/permissions after logout.

changes.before: A failed appdata load hung the app forever: guards never resolved and every BackendService CRUD call blocked silently.
changes.after: getAppData() errors while nothing is cached; guards redirect to /login/local; BaseAuthService.appDataError signal exposes the failure; repeated 401s clear the dead session and land on login?sessionExpired=true. Circuit-open rejections are a 401 with error.code === AUTH_CIRCUIT_OPEN_CODE. The appdata cache is reactive: computed()s reading table metadata recompute automatically when appdata loads.
changes.action: Optional: render appDataError in the app shell; handle the sessionExpired query param on the login page.

changes.before: datetime-local fields displayed the UTC wall-clock labeled as local and stamped local input as UTC, shifting stored times by the user's UTC offset on every edit.
changes.after: Display converts UTC ISO to local time; save converts local input back to UTC ISO. Name-suffix ('...Time') temporal guessing removed — only column metadata drives temporal handling.
changes.action: None. Expect displayed datetimes to change by the user's UTC offset relative to 1.1.9 (they are now correct).

changes.before: TableList silently showed the first 100 rows with no paginator and no sorting; stale search filters survived navigating to the bare list URL.
changes.after: Server-side paging (default 25/page, mat-paginator when total exceeds 10) with per-page client-side sorting; bare-URL navigation clears filters; fetch/save/delete errors render in the view.
changes.action: None; style .table-list__error and the paginator if desired.

changes.before: DisplayMode 'H'/'S' columns still rendered in lists, child grids and search/lookup forms; per-table hiddenFields leaked into search URLs; column defaults became implicit search filters.
changes.after: H/S filtered everywhere; buildSearchTerms honours tableOverrides.hiddenFields; search forms blank every seeded default.
changes.action: None. If a column vanished from a screen, its column_display_attribute says it should never have been there.

changes.before: The 2FA setup QR never rendered (keel returns an otpauth:// URI; it was bound to ).
changes.after: The URI is encoded client-side via the new 'qrcode' dependency (ships with sail). New [twoFactorEnabled] input on <sail-twofactor-setup> routes returning users to the disable form instead of silently rotating their seed.
changes.action: npm install pulls qrcode automatically. Pass [twoFactorEnabled] where the app knows the user's 2FA state.

changes.before: Any same-host response containing a 'data' key was unwrapped; any URL under the backend host was intercepted.
changes.after: Unwrapping requires keel's {data, meta} envelope shape and only /api/ + /public/ paths are in scope.
changes.action: None.

changes.before: Apps that mint JWTs out-of-band sometimes write localStorage['jwt'] directly.
changes.after: BaseAuthService.acceptToken(token) is the supported entry point (stores the token, resets the auth circuit, loads appdata, runs the OAuth return handoff).
changes.action: Replace raw localStorage writes with acceptToken().

changes.before: RestURL.payout*URL and paymentMethodSetDefaultURL default to '/api/v1/...'.
changes.after: Unchanged — payout routes are not in the Apis dictionary, so the version cannot be derived at runtime.
changes.action: Apps mounting keel's payout handler under a different prefix must override these via configureRestUrls.

changes.before: The cumulative guide did not explicitly account for versions 1.1.11 through 1.1.13.
changes.after: Those releases added payout API methods, password-policy validation, and consent improvements without a downstream API migration.
changes.action: None; the relevant behavior is included cumulatively in this guide.

changes.before: Downstream copies could call AgencyService.enrollReferral().
changes.after: The shared service exposes the commercial-model-neutral AgencyService.enroll() method only.
changes.action: Rename enrollReferral() calls to enroll(); no compatibility alias is shipped.

changes.before: Downstream agency screens could use app-local status domain ids such as billing_model or commission_status.
changes.after: StatusChipComponent uses keel basis domains agency_client_status, agency_billing_model, agency_commission_status, and agency_payout_status.
changes.action: Load keel v1.2.40 basis_seed.yml and remove divergent app-local ids. Values are client S/I/V/X; billing R/W; commission H/P/R/D/O; payout C/P/D/F/R/V/M.

changes.before: Each app maintained its own agency REST client, invitation page, client book, commission tables, payout history, and status labels.
changes.after: AgencyService and seven composable agency components are exported. Statuses come from keel constant catalogues, extra client columns are injected, and routes/brand/global CSS stay app-owned.
changes.action: Upgrade the backend to keel v1.2.41 (the invitation-accept flow branches on its RFC 7807 code 'agency_no_partner'), replace copied UI incrementally, and mount app-owned /agency and /agency/accept routes. Override RestURL.agency*URL if the backend is not mounted at /api/v1. Load keel basis_seed.yml (shipped since v1.2.40) so the canonical agency status domains are present.

changes.before: Downstream UIs could expose partner_client, partner_delegation, agency_commission_customer, agency_wholesale_enrollment, or commission-rule/tier/fixed-rate concepts.
changes.after: The contract uses agency_client_invitation, agency_client_delegation, agency_client_rate, and agency_profile.wholesaleAllowed. Rates are frozen percentage basis points; there is no rule-schedule DTO or UI.
changes.action: Rename imports and app-specific labels, remove rule/tier/fixed-rate screens, and treat wholesaleAllowed as permission for a per-client switch—not as the agency's global billing model.

changes.before: Agency totals were commonly divided by 100 and summed without regard to currency; payout destinations were admin-only CRUD.
changes.after: AgencyEarnings contains one balance per currency, formatMinorCurrency is exponent-aware, and AgencyPayoutProfileComponent selects only the authenticated user's fully onboarded destination while composing provider onboarding.
changes.action: Do not sum balances across currencies. Wire sealed tax-id storage in keel before enabling bank replacement, and style the new agency-* / commission-ledger classes in the app's global stylesheet.

changes.before: errorDetail(err, fallback) returned the caller's fallback whenever the error carried no RFC 7807 detail. A network failure, a CORS-blocked response and a proxy error page were therefore indistinguishable from a backend rejection, and the fallback string ("Could not save", "Registration failed") misattributed the fault to the API.
changes.after: errorDetail reports the two non-API cases distinctly: a transport failure (Angular status 0 — network down, CORS blocked, request aborted) returns "Cannot reach the server — the network or a CORS rule blocked the response.", and an unreadable body carrying a real status returns "<fallback> (HTTP <status>)". Bodies that do carry detail/title/message are unaffected. The new isTransportFailure(err) predicate exposes the status-0 case so callers can branch on it instead of matching the message text.
changes.action: None required — every call site keeps compiling and messages only improve. Apps that wrapped errorDetail locally to add this discrimination should delete the wrapper and call errorDetail directly. Any test asserting the exact fallback string for a status-0 or non-JSON-body case must be updated.
